title: Base64 from its specification
hints: Turn every rule of the summary into a check before decoding anything: length, where `=` may appear, and the alphabet. Then decode full groups of four, and handle a final group of two or three characters separately.

A final group of two characters carries 12 bits for 8 bits of data, so the low 4 bits of the second character must be zero; a group of three carries 18 bits for 16, so the low 2 bits of the third must be zero.
